changeSet.sql:
Any time you update this function, you must also increment version of dependent item(s) listed in changeset above, and update the version of the above changeset.
create or alter function [graph].[GetKeyPath] ( @segments xml ) returns nvarchar(850) WITH SCHEMABINDING as begin declare @path nvarchar(850)
select @path = '[' + V + ']' from ( select string_agg(Val, '].[') within group(order by P) as V from ( select X.p.value('./@level', 'int') as L, X.p.value('./@position', 'int') as P, X.p.value('.', 'nvarchar(250)') as Val from @segments.nodes('/path/segment') X(p) ) O ) O
if @path is null begin set @path = '[ERROR:KEY_FIELDS_NULL]' end
return @path end
